spec.description: Split & Join diagnostics for Domibus large-payload testing. Tracks fragment lifecycle, failures/retries, split/reassembly duration, fragment throughput, temporary storage and resource correlation. Split & Join-specific panels depend on the future normalized domibus_split_join_* metric contract; cAdvisor context panels already work.

spec.title: Active S&J Messages
spec.description: Currently active Split & Join messages. Empty until Split & Join runtime metrics are exposed.

spec.title: Pending Fragments
spec.description: Fragments waiting for the next Split & Join processing stage.

spec.title: Active Reassemblies
spec.description: Messages currently undergoing fragment reassembly.

spec.title: Fragment Failures
spec.description: Fragment failure rate. Any non-zero rate during a controlled Run should be investigated.

spec.title: Fragment Retries
spec.description: Fragment retry rate.

spec.title: Domibus Container CPU
spec.description: Current Domibus container CPU from cAdvisor. This works before Split & Join-specific metrics are added.

spec.title: Fragment Lifecycle Rate
spec.description: Rate of fragments created, sent, received and completed.

spec.title: Fragment Failures & Retries
spec.description: Failure and retry activity for Split & Join fragments.

spec.title: Pending Fragments
spec.description: Number of fragments waiting in Split & Join processing.

spec.title: Active Split & Join Messages
spec.description: Concurrent messages under Split & Join processing and reassembly.

spec.title: Split Duration — Average
spec.description: Average duration of payload splitting over the query window.

spec.title: Split Duration — p95
spec.description: 95th percentile payload split duration from the normalized histogram metric.

spec.title: Reassembly Duration — Average
spec.description: Average receiver-side fragment reassembly duration.

spec.title: Reassembly Duration — p95
spec.description: 95th percentile fragment reassembly duration.

spec.title: Fragment Byte Throughput
spec.description: Split & Join fragment byte throughput where the runtime exposes directional byte counters.

spec.title: Observed Fragment Size
spec.description: Average observed fragment size from the normalized histogram/summary contract.

spec.title: Split & Join Temporary Storage
spec.description: Temporary storage currently consumed by Split & Join fragment processing.

spec.title: Split & Join Temporary Files
spec.description: Current temporary fragment-file count, where exposed.

spec.title: Fragment Failures by Stage / Reason
spec.description: Failure counts over the current dashboard range, grouped by bounded stage/reason labels.

spec.title: Domibus CPU During Split & Join
spec.description: Container CPU context for correlating Split & Join activity with resource saturation.

spec.title: Domibus Memory During Split & Join
spec.description: Container working-set memory context for correlating Split & Join activity with memory pressure.

spec.title: Domibus Filesystem I/O During Split & Join
spec.description: Container filesystem I/O context for fragment creation, storage and reassembly.
